purpose: WI-397 perf/budget regression baselines. Ceilings/counts are the CONTRACT, set at/above current measured values to catch RE-bloat — the scar-tissue accumulation WI-369 only measures, made fail-closed here. A real justified increase means re-measuring and bumping this file in the same change (a deliberate, reviewed act).

context_budget.always_on_rules_note: The always-on rule SET is derived dynamically by the validator from skills-manifest.json rulesRegistry entries with auto_inject:"always" (currently 4) — NOT a hardcoded list here, so a new always-on rule is automatically counted (Gemini G6 #2). 2026-10 framework-5.5 audit: 11499B/5 rules -> 3053B/4 rules (tool-selection demoted to lazy; the other four cut to their load-bearing lines); ceiling 14000 -> 4000.
context_budget.catalog_desc_note: 2026-10 framework-5.5 audit: descriptions slimmed 45002 -> 25574 (the gate had been reading 0 chars since skills moved under skills/, so it never caught the 36K -> 45K re-bloat). Ceiling ~11% above current.

hook_spawn.note: Spawn COUNT per lifecycle event (deterministic; warm wall-clock is environment-flaky so we gate count, the real latency driver — each hook is a process spawn per matching tool event). Adding a hook fails this until the count is bumped here deliberately, forcing a latency-review. WI-384: PreToolUse 10→11 for svc-learning-inject (action-time learning injection). WI-392: PreToolUse 11→12 for svc-owner-inject (action-time intended-owner routing; fail-open + small lib + memo-cached; high value — attacks the #1 measured wrong-approach friction). WI-399 A1: PreToolUse 12->11 (svc-phase-boundary-detector merged into svc-workflow-guard default mode — same checks, one spawn) and svc-preflight-skill matcher narrowed *->Skill (runtime no-op spawns eliminated on every non-Skill tool event; count unchanged, latency win is per-event). WI-CLN-13 (plan §4.15): SubagentStart/SubagentStop each 0→1 for the new subagent telemetry hooks — these fire only on subagent lifecycle (spawn/stop), NOT per tool call, so they add no hot-path latency; both are append-only fail-open observers. WI-552: PreToolUse 11→12 for svc-continuation-phase-guard (matcher narrowed to Skill only, same pattern as svc-preflight-skill — a guaranteed no-op spawn on every non-Skill tool event; on Skill events it is a single small-file ledger scan gated by an early absent-baton short-circuit, so hot-path cost is a spawn plus a directory-listing miss for the overwhelming majority of sessions that never open a continuation baton). WI-FW-HOOKS-SAFETY-01 (2026-08-25): PreToolUse 12->13 and PostToolUse 10->11 in the hooks.json CATALOG only. Runtime spawn count per event DECREASED: all mutation guards (isolation/workflow/bash/loop/artifact-authenticity/contract-freshness/inertia) now run once inside the single svc-pretool-decision-engine child list instead of as separate wired processes; the catalog rows remain (annotated CONSOLIDATED) for cross-host gate coverage. The +1 PostToolUse row is svc-posttool-heartbeat, a fail-open observer that no-ops without a valid one-time receipt. WI-FW-CROSS-REPO-ORCH-02 / CI repair #70 (2026-09-20): SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit each 1->2 to account for the already-registered svc-origin-orchestrator-prompt required by AC-CAT-1. The prior baseline omitted that added process. This deliberately records its extra cold-start cost; it is not a measured speedup or a claim that two processes cost the same as one. The hook remains regex-first, bounded, fail-open and forbidden from spawning PLAN/EXEC; all other event ceilings and context/latency gates remain unchanged. Independent review must assess the increased lifecycle cost. 2026-10-11 hook audit: hooks/hooks.json now lists exactly what scripts/wire-hooks.mjs wires (validate-hooks-json-matches-wirer.mjs), so these ceilings count real entries. The earlier SessionStart 2 counted a drifted listing while 6 were wired. PreToolUse entries 9 -> 7 (rule-injector edit/bash + learning-inject + owner-inject folded into one svc-rule-injector process; svc-continuation-phase-guard wired on Skill as hooks.json had always claimed): per Edit/Write/Bash 4 -> 2 spawns. PostToolUse entries 10 -> 6 (accumulator, vibe auditor and post-edit auto-capture removed; phase-receipt autoemit one entry). SessionEnd/Notification 1 -> 0 and PreCompact 2 -> 1 (write-only loggers removed). SubagentStart/Stop were listed but never wired on Claude: 0.
